entities.name: GlmU
observations: Bacterial bifunctional enzyme, 450 aa, with strong full-length homologs Q1GTD8/Q2G929 showing 51–67% identity and approximately complete coverage.
Catalyzes the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis: glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase and UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase.
Curated homolog annotations report cytoplasmic localization, homotrimeric assembly, and one Mg2+ ion bound per subunit.

entities.name: GlmU acetylation step
observations: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H(+). EC 2.3.1.157; Rhea RHEA:13725.
This reaction is assigned to the C-terminal acetyltransferase domain in curated GlmU homologs.

entities.name: GlmU uridylation step
observations: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H(+) = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate. EC 2.7.7.23; Rhea RHEA:13509.
This reaction is assigned to the N-terminal UDP-GlcNAc diphosphorylase domain in curated GlmU homologs.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis
observations: GlmU performs the final two sequential reactions converting glucosamine-1-phosphate to UDP-N-acetylglucosamine, a precursor for peptidoglycan and lipid A biosynthesis.
